description: Use when an agent must track new U.S. rules, proposed rules, agency notices and fresh SEC disclosures. Input: optional q (topic), agency (Federal Register slug), doc_type, form (8-K, 13F-HR, NPORT-P...), source, days, limit. Output: JSON Federal Register documents (type, agencies, abstract, effective/comment dates, CFR, links) and latest SEC filings by companies/funds (form, filer, CIK, filed, link). Metadata only. Example: ?q=stablecoin&days=30 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

form.description: SEC forms, comma-separated (8-K, 13F-HR, NPORT-P, 10-K, 10-Q, 6-K, S-1, N-CSR); default 8-K,13F-HR,NPORT-P

q.description: Topic keywords (Federal Register full text; filters SEC filer names)

name: us_regs
title: U.S. regulatory & disclosure pack: Federal Register rules/notices + latest SEC 8-K, 13F, N-PORT filings
